why seated · The largest single release of machine-produced mathematics to date, published under one corporate author line, with a share of its claims formally stated against standard Mathlib and checkable by anyone. Seated so the release can be read, cited and checked at the bytes of a fixed commit, whatever the publisher later revises, moves or withdraws; and so its record of authorship stands beside it as data. The archive's independent kernel check of three headline results (scripts/verify_openai_math/, workflow verify-openai-math) reads from the same commit.
